title: Lights down, charms gather
caption:
Lights down. Your charms gather 🌙

Start the focus timer in Daily Charm and the room goes dim while your charms keep you company. The time left shows on your Lock Screen too.

Free to start on the App Store (iPhone). Search “Daily Charm”.

#focustimer #pomodoro #studytok #cozyapps #dailycharm

veo.prompt: Stop-motion style scene at night: a rug on the floor under the warm glow of a floor lamp in a dark room. Very subtle motion: the lamp's warm light flickers and breathes softly. Nothing new appears: no characters, no animals, no people, no objects are added, and nothing moves from its place. Locked-off static camera, no zoom, soft warm even light, calm and cozy.

end.line: Free to start on the App Store
